UNION ALL

SELECT
    s."id",
    s."name",
    s."role"
FROM
    "staff" s
WHERE
    LOWER(TRIM(s."language")) = 'english'
    AND LOWER(TRIM(s."role")) IN ('chef', 'server');
109:
SELECT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    s."system_id",
    s."system_name"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."id", s."system_id";
110:
SELECT
    its.id AS it_specialist_id,
    its.name AS it_specialist_name,
    s.system_name,
    s.is_active
FROM
    it_support_specialists its
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        s.system_name,
        s.is_active
    FROM
        systems s
    JOIN
        it_support_specialists_systems itss ON s.system_id = itss.system_id
    WHERE
        itss.it_specialist_id = its.id
) s;

    i."title" AS internship_title,
    r."responsibility" AS responsibility
FROM
    "internships" i

    "responsibilities" r ON ir."responsibilityid" = r."id";
